unresolved.where: Close preservations\Dynamics CRM Destination: verb (ActionType=3, DTSX:3182)
unresolved.reason: The integer->action mapping of KingswaySoft DestinationActionType lives in the KingswaySoft assembly, which is not supplied (blocked_external_dependency). Update vs Upsert (or another action) cannot be proven from the DTSX. Recorded verb UPDATE is the effective outcome only if the action writes fields: the record id comes from Gen_Preservation itself in the same flow, so Update and Upsert both modify the existing record. The mapping of three non-key Picklist fields (gen_currentstate, gen_generalresult, gen_preservationresault) makes a Delete action implausible but is not proof. RecordMatchingCriteria=1 with empty RecordMatchingKeyFields (DTSX:3185-3186) is likewise an assembly enum.
Column is unqualified in a 4-table join (Gen_Preservation p, gen_withdrawal w, gen_customercare t_out, gen_pensiontransferout pto); which table owns it depends on the CRM schema (not supplied).

notes.note: Business CRM writers: 1 (Dynamics CRM Destination -> gen_preservation, 3 attributes + primary key). The two script 'writers' listed by lineage (End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish, Close preservations\ETL Warning) and the script tasks Create ETL Process record, Close Preservations ETL Counter, Error ETL Process record are ETL plumbing (gen_etlprocess / gen_etlprocesswarning) and are not mapped.

All three written values are literals (Set columns DTSX:4860/4866/4872): gen_currentstate = 2, gen_generalresult = 2, gen_preservationresault = 57. Option-set labels are not in the DTSX (CRM metadata not supplied).
Gen_lastpreservationdate is selected by 'Get preservations' but is not an input of the destination; it only participates in the WHERE clause.

The first OR branch (gen_transferoutamountinactual is not null) does not test gen_currentstate, so preservations already closed in earlier runs are selected and rewritten with the same constants on every run (IgnoreUnchangedFields=false, DTSX props).
Package has no DTS:Configurations and no property expressions (grep of DTSX), so SQL and constants are as stored.

Graph coverage: tools/lineage.mjs lists this destination as kind crm-destination (crmConnection crm-service); inputs bind to external CRM attributes of the same name (DTSX:3205-3208). Remaining declaredSources are only the SQL WHERE columns of 'Get preservations' (row selection), which the graph cannot express.
